newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia Suburban to acquire two water systems.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia Suburban to acquire two water systems.

text.p: Philadelphia Suburban Corp said Friday that its major subsidiary, Philadelphia Suburban Water Co, intends to purchase two more water systems during the second quarter.

The company said the two area water companies under negotiations are small -- purchase prices of less than $1 million -- but strategically located in Montgomery and Bucks Counties, two of the fastest growing counties in Pennsylvania.
The company also said it has successfully begun service to the customers of Horsham Water Authority, its largest operations and maintenance contract, valued at approximately $500,000 annually.

The company said that a recent decline in PSC's stock price coincided with the recent general market decline, its customer growth record has kept PSC's fundamental business and financial position strong.
Philadelphia Suburban Corp is a regulated public utility that provides water to nearly 900,000 residents in 93 municipalities in suburban Philadelphia.
